_doc: The per-stage head table of the packets (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py): the longest printed text each stage may have, in characters, by case, route, run-directory length and CLI path length (the key 'inline/83/96' is route/run directory/CLI path). render_diff exits non-zero when a stage prints more than its value here or has none. A value changes in the commit that journals the new value (the plan's U1 re-baselines it for the merged branches, U7 sets the allocation); no other unit raises it. The first values are main da9e2e75 (skill-craft 2.5.0 / ShipLoop 1.5.0) rendered by packets.py --offline --text-dir and written by render_diff.py --emit-table DIR --write; they are ceilings, not targets, and a stage over the 20,000-character host cut is journaled as such, not hidden here. Re-measured 2026-10-17 by packet-review units U6/U8 (u6-gates, from packets.py --offline renders of each key): the result template's heading and the pointer's 'duties or the template' clause dropped (-68 per producer print), verify duty 1 writes the result before --check-only (+40); at inline/83/96 validate-existing's packet fell under PRINT_LIMIT and now prints whole (12,821 to 15,998, still under the 20,000 cut) and step-plan's head took its pause line into the freed room (19,894 to 19,943).
